summary: Citibank Credit Card Issuance Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting loss and delinquency experience for credit card receivables in Citibank Credit Card Master Trust I. This is a routine periodic disclosure for asset-backed securities, providing net loss percentages and delinquency data for the six-month period. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital action is involved. The filing is standard for ABS issuers and does not trigger any strategic or transactional classification.
